feed.title: warnahead: dataset changes
feed.subtitle: New deadlines, moved dates and status changes in the warnahead dataset, one entry per change.

entry.title: New deadline: Android NDK 26 is removed from the GitHub runner images
entry.content: Added with the date 2026-01-12, status In effect.

entry.title: New deadline: Android NDK 28 is removed from the GitHub runner images
entry.content: Added with the date 2026-10-01, status In effect.

entry.title: New deadline: New Android Automotive OS apps and updates must target API 35
entry.content: Added with the date 2026-08-31, status In effect.

entry.title: New deadline: Existing Flutter apps must target API 35 to stay available to new users
entry.content: Added with the date 2026-08-31, status In effect.

entry.title: New deadline: New Flutter apps and updates must target API 36
entry.content: Added with the date 2026-08-31, status In effect.

entry.title: New deadline: New Flutter apps and updates must target API 37
entry.content: Added with the date Aug 2027, status Announced.

entry.title: New deadline: App updates must support 16 KB memory pages
entry.content: Added with the date 2027-02-01, status Announced.

entry.title: Status changed: New apps and updates must target API 37
entry.content: The status changed from Expected, not announced to Announced.

entry.title: New deadline: New Android TV apps and updates must target API 34
entry.content: Added with the date 2025-08-31, status In effect.

entry.title: New deadline: New Wear OS apps and updates must target API 35
entry.content: Added with the date 2026-08-31, status In effect.

entry.title: New deadline: New Android XR apps and updates must target API 34
entry.content: Added with the date 2026-08-31, status In effect.

entry.title: First published dataset: 29 deadlines
entry.content: The dataset of 2026-11-11 lists 29 deadlines. Later changes appear in this feed one by one.
